acceptance_criteria.criterion: node scripts/cli.js doctor prints a report line for all 9 health checks.
Async slow-tier checks (e.g. personas-fresh) are awaited before the exit code is determined.
Exit code is 1 when one or more checks fail.
Exit code is 0 when all checks pass.
Each failing check shows the fix string sourced from the HEALTH_CHECKS registry entry.
Command key is 'v' (not 'd', which is taken by bundle-docs).

summary: Added async cmdDoctor(): calls runChecks('all'), awaits results, prints pass/fail per check with fix hint, calls process.exit(1) if any failed.
Added doctor command to COMMANDS (key: 'v', category: 'Validation & Utilities', helpVariants for CLI).
80 tests pass, CLI smoke test confirms doctor command appears in help.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified and met.

AC-1: CLI smoke test confirms all 9 health checks printed (mcp-dist, orchestrator-venv, hooks-installed, node-version, sibling-cli-menu, sibling-persona-builder, global-mcp-registered, mcp-dist-fresh, personas-fresh).
AC-2: runChecks('all') uses Promise.all with `raw instanceof Promise ? await raw : raw` — all tiers including slow are awaited.
AC-3: Exit code 1 confirmed — Global MCP registered failure triggered process.exit(1).
AC-4: process.exit(1) only called when anyFailed is true — all-pass path exits 0 implicitly.
AC-5: Fix hint 'node scripts/cli.js install-mcp' rendered dimly below the failing check.
AC-6: key: 'v' confirmed in source; bundle-docs holds 'd'. 80/80 workspace tests pass.

summary: Code review PASS. Reviewed cmdDoctor() and its COMMANDS entry in scripts/cli.js. Implementation is minimal and correct: runChecks('all') covers all tiers, anyFailed flag drives exit code, fix hints displayed with C.dim(), key 'v' confirmed. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: cmdDoctor() correctly awaits runChecks('all'), which covers all three cost tiers via Promise.all. The anyFailed flag pattern cleanly separates iteration from process.exit() — correct and idiomatic.

process.exit(1) in an async command is consistent with the cli.js convention (cmdBuildPersonas and others follow the same pattern). The interactive menu catches synchronous throws but not process.exit() — the doctor command is not intended for interactive use, only direct-mode. No issue.
No blocking issues. All 6 ACs confirmed met. Minimal, focused change: cmdDoctor() + one COMMANDS entry.
